answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 48905 Country: India Title: Marriage is allowed in the Month of Muharram? Question: Please tell me whether marriage can be fixed in the Month of Muhrram or it cannot be fixed. Please, reply. Answer ID: 48905 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1671/1337/B=13/1434) Yes, you can fix marriage in the month of Muharram as well. There is no wrong in marrying in Muharram. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
